blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings, glasses of wine, a snack menu including charcuterie baskets, indoor seating, an outdoor patio, and a wine bar. The winery hosts monthly Ladies Night events and various annual food and wine events throughout the year. The winery is located between Paw Paw and Mattawan, Michigan.
extraNote: Tasting room seating is first come first served; wine club members can make reservations anytime · Food events can cancel due to inclement weather; call ahead if weather is questionable · Igloo reservations required with prepayment; max group size 8; no outside food or drink allowed
